title: M1.2: External channel kind, message origin and conversation index
description:
Extend the channel model without adding a thread object: ChannelKind gains external, ActorKind gains external, ChannelMessageRecord gains an optional origin block (binding_id, provider, external_message_id, conversation_key, sender_external_id, assertion; absent means web). Add the conv index (binding + conversation key to channel_id) and the emsg index (normalized Message-ID to channel_id). Implement find-or-create for thread-granularity (new external channel named from the subject, participants = addressed bots plus the linked member) and pair-granularity (the member's existing direct channel via directChannelId). Update codecs and listing; existing messages without origin keep working because absence means web.

Acceptance criteria:
- A first message with a new conversation key creates one external channel; a second with the same key lands in that channel
- A pair-granularity message from a linked member lands in the member's existing direct channel with that bot
- Channel listing and message listing show origin; web-only channels are unchanged
- The external channel appears in the linked member's channel list; other members get 404
- Idempotent: replaying the same external message id creates no second channel or message

Gherkin: features/external_conversation_mapping.feature

Depends on: M1.1

Contract: the External channels contract (initiative description; draft docs/EXTERNAL_CHANNELS.draft.md).

Process: Gherkin first (AGENTS.md outside-in). Write the named feature, add it to features/cucumber-features.txt, implement steps in conversation/features-support/steps/, then production code. Vitest only for pure helpers. Both cucumber-js and vitest must pass. No emojis, no compatibility forks, tenant_id on every item, strangers get 404. Product PR into develop with sub-agent review.
